mood.basis: proxy: 0.35 x S&P 500 + 0.15 x avg(Nikkei, Kospi)

stories.title: Nifty surges 2.61% last week, gaining 656 points on strong FII inflows
stories.summary: The Nifty gained 2.61% last week, adding 656 points as strong FII inflows and improving technical indicators helped. Resistance lies at 25,950–26,200. Banking, IT and financial services lead sector momentum. Six sectors signal outperformance. Analysts advise caution against chasing extended market gains, so traders will watch whether foreign inflows continue in the coming sessions.
stories.why: Steady foreign inflows are the main support for the index, so any reversal in flows would matter quickly.

stories.title: Gold hits a 14-month low on MCX at ₹1,21,949 per 10 gm
stories.summary: MCX gold finished at a 14-month low of ₹1,21,949 per 10 gm on Friday. International gold ended at $3,539/oz. Experts list three reasons for the drop in gold prices in 2026. The fall is a talking point for savers asking whether gold can reach ₹1 lakh again. Traders will watch how prices open next week.
stories.why: Falling gold eases pressure on India's import bill but hurts sentiment for gold lenders.

stories.title: Hospital stocks rally up to 14% over five sessions
stories.summary: Hospital stocks rallied up to 14% over five trading sessions, helped by optimism about corporate earnings and growth prospects. Apollo Hospitals, Fortis, Max Healthcare and Aster DM Quality Care all advanced on Friday. Brokerages maintain Buy ratings on Apollo, Fortis and Max. Investors will watch whether the rally holds after such a sharp short-term run.
stories.why: Optimism on earnings and growth is drawing money into healthcare, a sector that often holds up in choppy markets.

stories.title: Adani Energy Solutions gets order for 1,750 MW renewable power supply to West Bengal
stories.summary: Adani Energy Solutions has received an order for 1,750 MW of renewable power supply to West Bengal. Supply for the initial 1,750 MW is scheduled to begin on July 1, 2028. If a 750 MW greenshoe option is exercised, supply for that extra capacity is scheduled to begin from April 1, 2029.
stories.why: A long-dated supply order adds revenue visibility for the company.

stories.title: Texmaco Rail gets ₹230 crore orders from JSW entities for 553 wagons
stories.summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering has secured two letters of intent worth ₹230.58 crore. They come from JSW Rail Infra Logistics and JSW (South) Rail Logistics. The company will manufacture and supply 553 wagons under the orders, with deliveries due by mid-2027. The orders add to the wagon maker's order book for the coming year.
stories.why: Order wins fill the wagon maker's book for the next year or so.

stories.title: Premier Explosives gets ₹311-crore export order for defence explosives
stories.summary: Premier Explosives has received an export order worth ₹311 crore, or $33.603 million, from an international entity. The order is for defence explosives. It is to be executed within 12 months. For a small company, an export order of this size is notable and points to overseas demand for its defence products.
stories.why: A sizeable export order is large for a small-cap and shows overseas defence demand.

stories.title: Taiwan widens short-sale curbs after its worst weekly fall in 35 years
stories.summary: Taiwan has widened curbs on short sales of local stocks and said it has been buying shares. The aim is to revive confidence after the island's benchmark index had its worst weekly fall in 35 years. The plunge came on concern about AI. Traders in Asia will watch whether the measures calm the market.
stories.why: Stress in Asian chip markets can spill over to Indian risk appetite and IT stocks.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields ₹8,981 crore IPO stays undersubscribed after two days
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields' ₹8,981 crore IPO remained undersubscribed after two days. Its grey-market premium plunged 92% to ₹0.70, implying just 0.51% potential listing gains. Brokerages remain positive on its production scale, cash flows and dividends, but near-term investor demand is weak. The final day of bidding will show how much interest the issue gets.
stories.why: Weak demand for a big issue shows investors are choosy on pricing despite the rally.

stories.title: Hero MotoCorp gets ITAT relief on ₹27 crore tax demand for six assessment years
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has received relief from the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal on a ₹27 crore tax demand covering six assessment years. The company said in a filing that it downloaded the appeal order, dated November 20, 2026, from the ITAT portal on the same day. The amount is small for the company.
stories.why: The relief removes a small tax liability; the amount is minor for the company.

stories.title: Gold and silver crash: DSP Mutual Fund turns bullish and buys in stages
stories.summary: Gold prices plunged to a 14-month low, recording their steepest weekly decline in eight months. Interest-rate concerns and an AI-stock selloff weighed on the metal. DSP Mutual Fund is gradually buying gold and silver as prices fall. It uses predefined price levels instead of trying to predict a market bottom.
stories.why: The fund's staged buying shows how some investors approach a sharp fall in bullion.

stories.title: Indo Borax, GOCL and Bayer CropScience offer dividend yields of up to 10%
stories.summary: Three specialty chemical stocks offer high dividend yields. Indo Borax & Chemicals leads with a 10.3% FY26 yield, followed by GOCL Corporation at 9.7% and Bayer CropScience at 4.6%. The companies announced dividends of ₹40, ₹30 and ₹150 per share respectively.
stories.why: High payouts draw income-focused investors to small chemical makers.

stories.title: Patanjali Foods board to consider second interim dividend on Nov 26
stories.summary: Patanjali Foods will meet on November 26, 2026, to consider and approve a second interim dividend for FY27. The amount and record date have not been announced. Its trading window has been closed since November 21. It will reopen 48 hours after the dividend declaration.
stories.why: The board meeting will reveal the size of the payout.

stories.title: Cohance Lifesciences facility gets USFDA 'voluntary action indicated' status
stories.summary: Cohance Lifesciences said the USFDA has concluded its inspection of the Shamshabad facility in Telangana. The regulator classified the site as Voluntary Action Indicated. It also issued an Establishment Inspection Report. The company announced the outcome in a stock exchange filing.
stories.why: A VAI result usually means no further regulatory action is needed.

stories.title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
stories.summary: GSTN has introduced metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system. The addition follows a government notification released on October 26. The system now includes five modes: road, rail, air, ship and metro rail. Users must select metro rail and enter transport document numbers.
stories.why: A small compliance change for businesses moving goods by metro rail.
